scope: Present core of Port Alberni Mill at 4000 Stamp Avenue, showing the three named waterfront mill outlines and their main industrial roof, power and processing forms.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The operator identifies the continuing Port Alberni paper mill at 4000 Stamp Avenue and describes product and energy use.
The regional district dates the installation and shutdown of different lines and records changes to the boiler and its stack.
Permit PA-01863, amended 1999, describes the combined boiler stack, chip cyclones, paper-dryer vents and separate processing functions. Used written facts only.
